fieldLegend.sourceReference: binding/policy/edge/reader indexes are authoritative exact anchors; each row selects all applicable entries

T.target: source-verified shape binding before measurement; retain OUTSIDE_TRANSACTION, named typed task reader, fresh facts, owner-local read-only projections, no edge JDBC/dispatcher/cache/cross-schema write inference
T.acceptance: fixture plus future immutable snapshot proves declared cap, total reconciliation and UNCLASSIFIED=0; SOURCE_IMPLEMENTED_UNMEASURED is not success
T.red: row/anchor/binding substitution; undeclared owner projection, nonzero extras, cap breach, UNCLASSIFIED or reader bypass fails

E.target: protocol/content read, not task reader; do not invent task-query budget
E.acceptance: binding and REQUIRED_NO_BUDGET evidence remain in 83 denominator
E.red: missing reason/evidence, omitted row or task-read misclassification fails

gaps.G1: No per-operation numeric CONTEXT_* floor is declared by policy; only the four listed components are exact. This is a source gap, not an inferred budget.
gaps.G2: Policy declares OPTIONAL_COUNT=1 but supplies no user-task/query-chain explanation; do not invent one.

staleRevokeAnchorBaseline.constraint: repair plus lost-member red mutation precedes shape extension; this catalog claims neither

getPlatformContractOverviewDetail.userTask: 平台管理员查看合同详情及该合同 host 的 extension 字段标签
getPlatformContractOverviewDetail.explanation: 合同 view 与 extension definition 分属 store-contract 和 extension owner；合并会形成跨 schema join 或删减既有 response 字段

getPlatformEntityAuditHistory.userTask: 平台管理员按实体类型查看平台审计历史
getPlatformEntityAuditHistory.explanation: GROUP_WORKSPACE 的平台工作区审计与组织初始化审计分属不同 owner；其它 branch 保持单 owner，不能以跨 owner SQL 或删除审计事实合并

getPlatformGroupWorkspaceDetail.userTask: 平台管理员查看商业组工作区详情、初始化、资产引用及账号角色汇总
getPlatformGroupWorkspaceDetail.explanation: 详情输出分别由 platform-workspace、organization、asset 与 workspace-iam owner 持有；合并会跨 schema 或删减既有 HTTP 事实

getPlatformOrganizationOverviewDetail.userTask: 平台管理员查看组织管理详情及 host 的 extension 字段标签
getPlatformOrganizationOverviewDetail.explanation: 组织 base detail 与 extension definition 分属 organization 和 extension owner；合并会形成跨 schema join 或删减未配置 host 的空字段语义

getWorkspaceAccount.userTask: 平台管理员查看单个工作区账号、assignment、role 与组织展示路径
getWorkspaceAccount.explanation: workspace-iam account detail projection plus one organization display-path batch; two owner-local projections prevent cross-schema joins and per-assignment path reads

getWorkspaceAccounts.userTask: 平台管理员分页查看工作区账号、assignment、role 与组织展示路径
getWorkspaceAccounts.explanation: workspace-iam account/assignment/role page projection plus one organization display-path batch; two owner-local projections prevent cross-schema joins and per-account path reads

getWorkspaceInvitation.userTask: 平台管理员查看单个工作区邀请、intent、issuer 与组织展示路径
getWorkspaceInvitation.explanation: workspace-iam invitation detail/intents projection plus one organization display-path batch; two owner-local projections prevent cross-schema joins and per-intent path reads

getWorkspaceInvitationCandidates.userTask: 平台管理员按 organization 或 role 主体获取工作区邀请候选项

chain.selectionInvariant: exactly one organization boundary is selected by subjectType

getWorkspaceInvitationCandidates.explanation: workspace-iam candidate-reference projection plus one organization platform-invitation-candidate batch; two owner-local projections prevent cross-schema joins and per-candidate lookup

getWorkspaceInvitations.userTask: 平台管理员分页查看工作区邀请、intent、issuer 与组织展示路径
getWorkspaceInvitations.explanation: workspace-iam invitation/intents/issuer page projection plus one organization display-path batch; two owner-local projections prevent cross-schema joins and per-invitation path reads

listPlatformGroupWorkspaces.userTask: 平台管理员分页查看商业组工作区、组织初始化路径与资产公开引用
listPlatformGroupWorkspaces.explanation: 页面输出分别由 platform-workspace、organization 与 asset owner 持有；合并会跨 schema 或删减已有列表事实
